title: Projektetage Catalogue Grid Fidelity
description: Bauteilkatalog tile grid looks different from the original bauteilbörse.png. Full catalogue figure must use the same stretch-to-frame rendering as split tiles, not object-fit cover on img.
summary: Fixed catalogue mosaic tiles showing wrong neighbours (e.g. Rippenplatte 1 bleeding into 2). Mosaic tiles now use figureCropBackgroundPosition(crop) instead of edge-aligned grid percentages, and mosaic rest drops the extra coverScale zoom (uniform 100/crop.width % auto only). Reordered figureCropIsFullImage before use; fixed mosaic coverScale boolean. Renderer tests: 101 passed.
